title: Project scaffolding: monorepo with /frontend (React Vite) and /backend (Spring Boot Maven)
desc: Initialize monorepo with React Vite frontend (pnpm) and Spring Boot 3.x backend (Maven, Java 17+). Vite dev proxy for /api/* to Spring Boot.

title: MySQL database with Spring Data JPA entities for products, users, orders, cart
desc: Spring Data JPA (Hibernate) with MySQL. Entities: Product, ProductVariant, Category, User, Cart, CartItem, Order, OrderItem, Review. Connection via .env variables.

title: Responsive storefront homepage with hero, featured collections, category filters
desc: Homepage with hero banner, featured product collections, category navigation, and responsive layout. Modern minimal aesthetic with Tailwind CSS.

title: Product search and sort functionality
desc: Search bar with real-time filtering. Sort by price (low/high), newest, popularity. Debounced search input.

title: Product detail page with image gallery, variants, stock status, reviews preview
desc: PDP with image gallery/carousel, size/color variant selector, stock status badge, reviews preview section, add-to-cart button.

title: Persistent shopping cart with add, remove, update quantity, promo code, live subtotal
desc: Cart drawer/page with quantity controls, remove items, promo code input, live subtotal/total calculation. Persisted across sessions (localStorage for guests, DB for logged-in).

title: Multi-step checkout flow with form validation and shipping options
desc: Multi-step checkout: shipping info form (validation), shipping method selection, order review step. Guest checkout supported.

title: Stripe test mode payment integration
desc: Stripe Checkout or PaymentIntent integration in test mode. Keys from .env, never hardcoded. Payment confirmation page.

title: Order confirmation page with order summary
desc: Post-payment confirmation page showing order number, items, total, estimated delivery. Email receipt placeholder.

title: Customer authentication: signup, login, profile, JWT httpOnly cookies
desc: Spring Security + JWT. Signup (email, password, name), login, profile page, JWT in httpOnly cookies. Password hashing with BCrypt.

title: Order history for authenticated users
desc: Order history page listing past orders with status, date, total. Click to view order details.

title: Admin dashboard: product CRUD, inventory management
desc: Admin panel with product create/edit/delete, variant management, inventory stock updates. Protected by admin role.

title: Admin dashboard: order management and status updates
desc: Admin order list with filtering/search, order detail view, status update (pending/processing/shipped/delivered/cancelled).

title: Dark/light mode with system preference detection and manual toggle
desc: Theme system with system preference detection (prefers-color-scheme), manual toggle, persisted preference. All components themed.

title: Empty, loading, and error states for all data-fetching views
desc: Skeleton loaders, empty state illustrations, error boundaries with retry. No blank or broken states visible to users.

title: Accessibility: keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, contrast compliance
desc: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance: keyboard navigation, focus indicators, ARIA labels on interactive elements, sufficient color contrast.

title: SEO meta tags and semantic HTML
desc: React Helmet or equivalent for page titles, descriptions, Open Graph tags. Semantic HTML5 elements throughout.

title: Seed data: 15-20 fashion products with variants and placeholder images
desc: Database seeder (SQL or Spring Boot DataLoader) with 15-20 fashion items across categories, each with size/color variants and picsum.photos placeholder images.

title: Design tokens and cohesive component library with Tailwind
desc: Tailwind CSS design tokens (colors, spacing, typography scale). Reusable component patterns: Button, Input, Card, Badge, Modal, Drawer. Consistent across app.

title: End-to-end verification: build, test, live smoke check
desc: Full build passes (frontend + backend), automated tests pass, live smoke check with running app serves pages correctly.
